description: Floating-point division followed by ceiling can push a limiting dimension above its maximum, and patch alignment amplifies the overshoot.
trigger: Call the new helper with input_size=(230,1), max_size=(224,192), patch_size=(16,32).
expected_behavior: Return patch-aligned dimensions no larger than (224,192), as promised by the bounding-box contract.
actual_behavior: The scalar transcription produces (240,32): the computed limiting dimension rounds up to 225 before alignment. The source has no final clamp. No repository callers were found in the parent, and the diff introduces none, so reach is limited to direct prospective or external use.

verification.description: Swept input dimensions 1 through 300 using the inspected scaling and alignment formulas.
verification.limits: Used standard-library math.ceil rather than NumPy ceil; did not execute the repository helper or image resizing.
